caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object positioned diagonally on a plain, beige background. The object has a long, turned handle that is white or light gray in color with several segments, knobs, and a rounded bulb near the upper part. At the top, the handle meets a decorative element featuring elaborate gold filigree with intricate scrollwork and floral patterns. Attached to this decorative gold section are three prominent, curved elements rendered in a vivid blue color, evenly spaced around the crown-like structure. Extending from the gold section is a fine gold chain that ends in a thin, pointed stick or pin, also gold in color. The composition centers the object slightly to the left of the image, leaving ample empty space around it. There are no other visible objects or elements in the drawing.
title: Bouquet Holder
